dialogue.text: Hello Rachel, it's Adrian Lim. I'm calling about the investment note in my files. I have the paperwork beside me, although I've rather mixed it up with my business correspondence.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good morning, Adrian. Could you give me your identification number and date of birth before we discuss the account?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My identification number is G four four five eight five two oh X. My date of birth is 23 February 1962. Following my investment note, please buy 2,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a limit order at a limit price of 495 American dollars. The transaction currency is American dollars, and my transaction amount is 1,000,000.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Take a moment to check your records before we continue.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Actually, my upcoming liquidity needs take priority over that older investment note. Cancel that unexecuted instruction in full; I want to replace it with a disposal from my existing holding. I've been delegating more of the distribution business to my management team, and my own paperwork needs some attention too.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: It sounds like a busy handover. We can arrange future portfolio review calls around your availability rather than interrupting your working day. Would you prefer an email to arrange those?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: An email would be best. My diary is still changing as the team takes over more responsibilities. Please let me suggest a suitable time when you write. Now, back to the statement. Let me check the holding statement; the quantity I want to dispose of is— I've found the holding entry now: please sell 2,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a market order. For this replacement order, the transaction currency is Japanese yen and the transaction amount I am specifying is 1,000,000.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll use email to arrange future reviews. I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because that lowers your concentrated technology exposure and releases funds for your personal needs.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Please keep the explanation concise. I would like to be able to refer back to the written material afterwards without making extensive notes during the call.
